submission.justification: Based on comprehensive simulation studies, Absorber-F1 at 4.8 mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution of 3.136% at 100 GeV for electromagnetic showers. This configuration was identified by systematically scanning plate thicknesses from 2 to 10 mm for all three candidate absorber materials. Absorber-F1 significantly outperforms Absorber-F2 (best: 5.004% at 6 mm) and Absorber-F3 (best: 3.934% at 4 mm). The optimum thickness of 4.8 mm represents a balance between sampling frequency and shower containment for this dense alloy material with short radiation length. All candidate materials are compatible with the mechanical support design and can be machined to required tolerances, making Absorber-F1 the clear choice for achieving the goal of best possible energy resolution while meeting all constraints.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 at 4.8 mm achieves 3.136% resolution, superior to Absorber-F3 (3.934% at 4 mm) and Absorber-F2 (5.004% at 6 mm)

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 is one of the three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) listed in the specifications

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
requirements.evidence: All three candidate materials are presented as viable options in the project documentation without any exclusions based on activation or radiation safety concerns. The candidates were pre-screened for project requirements.
Recommended thickness of 4.8 mm is within the allowed range of 2-10 mm
